classification: Pinned source and linked-firmware search-policy clarification; not physical boot acceptance
conclusions: Exact candidate disables CONFIG_EFI_LOADER and has no EFI scan in linked default environment.
bootcmd replaces boot_targets with nvme; bootcmd_nvme exists with devnum 0.
Five Linux-filesystem-type GPT entries with attributes zero yield no bootable partitions, empty env assignment deletes devplist, and scanner falls back to partition 1.
Prefixes / and /boot/, extlinux and boot.scr.uimg/boot.scr scan remain broader than script guards.
Complete produced-filesystem whitelist and physical boot acceptance remain required.

gpt_preconditions.result: No bootable partition list; empty assignment removes devplist, so scanner selects partition 1.

limits: Corrects current documentation describing EFI scanning in this exact candidate; historical producer proofs remain unchanged.
Script/extlinux alternatives and both prefixes remain; the script guards do not close the whole firmware search policy.
Generated image GPT preconditions and complete boot-filesystem whitelist must be verified on the actual new artifact.
No physical SPI boot, backup/recovery/programming, zero routine SD writes or KVM guest execution acceptance.

selected_environment.distro_bootcmd: for target in ${boot_targets}; do run bootcmd_${target}; done
selected_environment.nvme_boot: if nvme dev ${devnum}; then setenv devtype nvme; run scan_dev_for_boot_part; fi
selected_environment.scan_dev_for_boot: echo Scanning ${devtype} ${devnum}:${distro_bootpart}...; for prefix in ${boot_prefixes}; do run scan_dev_for_extlinux; run scan_dev_for_scripts; done;
selected_environment.scan_dev_for_boot_part: part list ${devtype} ${devnum} -bootable devplist; env exists devplist || setenv devplist 1; for distro_bootpart in ${devplist}; do if fstype ${devtype} ${devnum}:${distro_bootpart} bootfstype; then run scan_dev_for_boot; fi; done
